items.statement: Redesigning the contact pathway (blood draw at the first home visit, results routed to the case nurse, X-ray booked at the result visit) raises completion within 60 days from 71 percent to at least 85 percent within 12 months, without lower completion for shelter, shift-working or interpreter-needing contacts.
items.rationale: A comparable redesign achieved a similar change (c2) and home testing is the best supported element (c3); the equity condition follows c5.
items.risks: Nurse workload; hospital radiology booking outside the program's control.

items.statement: Median days from contact identification to completed evaluation falls below 25.
items.rationale: Time fell from 41 to 19 days elsewhere.

items.statement: Most remaining losses occur between a positive test and the radiograph.
items.rationale: The retrieved cascade found its largest loss there (c1).

summary: Three hypotheses; h1 is the improvement aim with an equity condition.
